summary.purpose: Provide a browser UI for a local CommerceLens sandbox where users browse products, place demo orders, and inspect order and notification history.
interfaces: No programmatic interfaces exposed (consumer-only browser frontend)
data: Checkout payload: customerEmail, postalCode, items, paymentScenario, shippingScenario
Order details: id, status, items, subtotalCents, shippingCents, totalCents, paymentId, trackingNumber, failureReason, createdAt
Tab-scoped idempotency Attempt (key + payload) in sessionStorage
flow: User adds or removes items in cart
User enters email, postal code, and selects demo payment/shipping scenarios
Frontend validates checkout inputs and stock availability
Frontend persists Idempotency-Key and Checkout payload in sessionStorage
Frontend POSTs checkout to backend with Idempotency-Key header
Frontend displays order status, tracking, error explanation, or network warning
User views order history and notification records in the Operations tab
unknowns: The portal page uses example status names CONFIRMED/PAYMENT_FAILED; the Order wiki uses lowercase states including payment_unknown. Consult the Order failure-handling page for the documented state distinctions.

review: Codex reviewed against selected service wiki pages; removed unsupported ambiguity claims and distinguished provider boundaries from mock deployments.

location_migration.reason: Paths and links only; existing summary preserved, no model call.
